## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload micro-dlrm-train --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload micro-dlrm-train --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload micro-dlrm-train --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload micro-dlrm-train --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

**Reviewer notes:**

- ROC AUC is evaluated once on the untouched official u1.test split after a fixed 21-epoch schedule. Evaluation labels do not select a checkpoint, and training seeds do not alter split membership. The feature recipe excludes rating-derived user or item aggregates.
